annotations.title: Live fuel prices at the pump

description: Use this when a user asks the current price of petrol, diesel, E10, E85, LPG or CNG near a place in Queensland, Western Australia, Brazil, Ontario, Canada, Colombia, Costa Rica, Spain, the EU (national averages), Finland, France, the United Kingdom (national averages), Hong Kong, Italy, Montenegro, Mexico, Malaysia, the Netherlands, Norway, New Zealand, Singapore, Thailand, Taiwan, the United States or Uruguay, or where fuel is cheapest there. Returns the median and typical range of pump prices across stations in the area, the three cheapest stations, and the official source and licence. How fresh: Queensland: monthly file, published about a month after the month ends (the newest data is usually 5 to 8 weeks old); Western Australia: daily: the current month's file is extended each day with the previous day's prices; our copy is taken once a day and every answer states the day it is for; Brazil: ANP publishes the survey as one file per month, so the newest survey week is usually one to four weeks old. Our copy is refreshed daily, and every answer states the survey week it describes; Ontario: weekly (Mondays, before the end of the business day; the next working day after a holiday); Canada: monthly, not live: Statistics Canada publishes each month's averages about two weeks after the month ends (August 2026 was released on 14 September 2026), and every answer states its reference month; Colombia: one figure per station per month, published at the start of the month; the answer states the month; Costa Rica: updated when ARESEP fixes a new tariff (about once a month, sometimes more often); every answer states the date the price applies from; Spain: several times a day; the EU (national averages): weekly: Monday prices, published that week; Finland: monthly, about three months after the month ends (table updated 24 September 2026 with June 2026); every answer states the month it is for; France: about every 10 minutes; the United Kingdom (national averages): weekly: one national figure each week, usually available the same week; Hong Kong: updated by the Consumer Council as and when prices change; the file carries no date, so the date shown is the day ProofPrice fetched it; Italy: daily (prices at 08:00 of the extraction day); Montenegro: new prices are published about every week (usually Tuesday); every answer states the date the price applies from; Mexico: the feeds are current prices reported by the stations and carry no timestamps; our copy is taken once a day and every answer shows the day of that copy; Malaysia: weekly, on Thursdays; the Netherlands: weekly publication of daily averages: new days appear each Thursday, up to the Monday of that week; every answer states the day it is for; Norway: monthly; the newest month is normally published in the first weeks of the next month (table updated 21 October 2026 with September 2026); every answer states the month it is for; New Zealand: weekly (Fridays), using the previous week's data; the newest weeks are marked Provisional by MBIE and revised; Singapore: monthly, about three weeks after the month ends, with the month named in every answer; Thailand: monthly national retail prices; the file is updated by EPPO when a new month is added (check the period in each answer); Taiwan: changes usually on Mondays; the next week's list price is published the day before; the United States: weekly: EIA dates each figure to the Monday it describes and publishes it a day or two later (a day later after a federal holiday); our copy of EIA's history files is refreshed daily and every answer states its week; the United States: weekly in the heating season (October to March, published Wednesdays); EIA collects no heating oil or propane prices from April to September, so in summer the newest week is from March. Our copy of EIA's files is refreshed daily and every answer states its week; Uruguay: monthly: the price in force in each month; a month without a quotation is marked S/C by ANCAP. Do not use for other countries or for historical prices.

area.description: Wider area when no postcode. AU (Queensland only): 'Brisbane' (postcodes 4000 to 4179) or 'QLD' (the whole state). A suburb name also works. AU (Western Australia only): 'Perth' (the Metro region), 'WA' (the whole state), a FuelWatch region such as 'Peel' or 'South West', or a suburb name. BR: state as a two-letter code or name ('SP', 'Minas Gerais'); leave empty for all Brazil. Ontario: same as town (a market, or Ontario / Southern Ontario / Northern Ontario). Canada: same as town (a city, or 'Canada'). Provinces are not published. CO: department, for example 'Antioquia', 'Cundinamarca', 'Valle del Cauca'. Empty = the whole country. Costa Rica: not used (national price only). ES: province code ('28' = Madrid). EU Weekly Oil Bulletin countries: not used (national average only). Finland: not used (national average only). FR: department ('69', '2A'). GB: not used (national average only). HK: not used (territory-wide figure only). IT: province ('MI', 'RM'). Montenegro: not used (national price only). MX: state name or code ('Ciudad de México', 'CDMX', 'Jalisco', 'NLE'); leave empty for all Mexico. Only states are available. MY: not used (national price only). Netherlands: not used (national average only). Norway: not used (national average only). NZ: not used (national price only). SG: not used (national price only). TH: not used (national price only). TW: not used (island-wide price only). US: a state ('TX', 'California') or PADD region ('Gulf Coast', 'PADD 1B', 'West Coast'); leave empty for the national average. EIA publishes gasoline for CA, CO, FL, MA, MN, NY, OH, TX and WA, diesel only for California plus the nation and PADD regions. Any other place gets the national average, and the answer says so (with its region as context). US heating oil and propane: not used (national average only). Uruguay: not used (national maximum price only).

country.description: AU = Australia, Queensland only (monthly station prices reported to the Queensland Government); AU = Australia, Western Australia only (FuelWatch daily station prices); BR = Brazil (ANP weekly survey: regular petrol and diesel S10); CA = Canada (Ontario markets only here: Ministry of Energy weekly average pump price in CAD per litre; other Canadian places come from Statistics Canada); CA = Canada (Statistics Canada: monthly average retail price by city, official statistic, not a live pump price); CO = Colombia (compressed natural gas only, monthly station prices from SICOM; no gasoline or diesel); CR = Costa Rica (regulator ARESEP: national maximum price, not a station price); ES = Spain; EU Weekly Oil Bulletin, national average pump prices: IE = Ireland, AT = Austria, DE = Germany, NL = the Netherlands, BE = Belgium, PT = Portugal, PL = Poland, DK = Denmark, SE = Sweden, FI = Finland, LU = Luxembourg, GR = Greece, CZ = Czechia, SK = Slovakia, SI = Slovenia, HR = Croatia, HU = Hungary, RO = Romania, BG = Bulgaria, EE = Estonia, LV = Latvia, LT = Lithuania, CY = Cyprus, MT = Malta; FI = Finland (Statistics Finland: monthly national average pump price, official statistic, not a live pump price); FR = France; GB = United Kingdom (DESNZ weekly national average pump prices of unleaded petrol and diesel); HK = Hong Kong (posted pump prices of five oil companies, Consumer Council; posted prices, not station prices); IT = Italy; ME = Montenegro (government maximum price, not a station price); MX = Mexico (by state); MY = Malaysia (weekly government-set national price; an official published price, not a station price); NL = Netherlands (CBS: daily national average pump price, official statistic, a few days behind); NO = Norway (Statistics Norway: monthly national average pump price, official statistic, not a live pump price); NZ = New Zealand (MBIE weekly national average retail price; an official statistic, not a station price); SG = Singapore (Department of Statistics monthly national average pump price; an official statistic, not a station price); TH = Thailand (EPPO monthly national average retail price; an official statistic, not a station price); TW = Taiwan (posted island-wide list price of CPC Corporation; a posted price, not a station price); US = United States (U.S. Energy Information Administration: weekly average retail gasoline and diesel prices in US$ per gallon for the nation, PADD regions, 9 states and 10 cities); US = United States (EIA: weekly national average residential heating oil and propane prices in US$ per gallon, October to March); UY = Uruguay (ANCAP: monthly maximum pump price set by decree, national, IVA included; not a station price)

fuel.description: petrol95 = unleaded 95; methane = CNG (priced per kg). Queensland: diesel, petrol95 (= standard Unleaded, 91 RON), petrol98, e10, e85 or lpg. Western Australia: diesel, petrol95 (= standard unleaded ULP, 91 RON), petrol98, lpg or e85. Brazil: petrol95 = regular petrol (gasolina comum, not RON 95) or diesel (= diesel S10). Other fuels are not covered. Ontario: petrol95 = regular unleaded, petrol98 = premium unleaded, diesel, propane, methane = compressed natural gas (per litre of gasoline equivalent). E10, E85, LPG and heating oil are not published. Canada: petrol95 = regular unleaded gasoline (87 AKI, about 91 RON), petrol98 = premium unleaded, diesel; self-service stations. E10, E85, LPG and CNG are not published. CO: only methane (vehicular natural gas, GNCV), in COP per cubic metre (not per kg). Gasoline and diesel are not available. Costa Rica: petrol95 (Gasolina RON 95) or diesel (automotive, 50 ppm), the regulated maximum price in colones per litre with IVA. Gasolina RON 91 is given in the answer as extra information. EU Weekly Oil Bulletin countries: petrol95 (Euro-super 95), diesel (automotive gas oil) or lpg, as a national average per litre in euro with all taxes; heating gas oil is in the extra fields. Other fuels are not published. Finland: petrol95 (95 E10 unleaded) or diesel, as a national monthly average per litre in euro with VAT and duties. Premium petrol, E85, LPG, CNG, heating oil and renewable diesel are not served. France: petrol95 means SP95 only (about a quarter of French 95-octane stations, and the dearer fuel). Most stations sell E10 instead, which is a separate item and already available: ask for fuel=e10 for the common 95-octane petrol. Also diesel, petrol98 (SP98), e85 and lpg. GB: petrol95 (unleaded petrol, ULSP) or diesel (ULSD) only, as a national average in pounds per litre; other fuels are not published. HK: diesel, petrol95 (the Consumer Council's standard petrol) or petrol98 (premium petrol), in HKD per litre; the answer is the median of five companies' posted prices. Italy: diesel, petrol95, lpg, methane only. Montenegro: petrol95 (Eurosuper 95) or diesel (Eurodiesel), the government maximum retail price in euro per litre with taxes. Eurosuper 98 and heating oil are given in the answer as extra information. Mexico: petrol95 = regular petrol (gasolina regular, Magna), petrol98 = premium petrol, or diesel. Mexican grades are not 95 or 98 RON. MY: diesel, petrol95 (RON95, unsubsidised rate) or petrol98 (answered with RON97). Subsidised BUDI95/SKPS/SKDS prices are in extra.subsidised_myr_per_litre. Netherlands: petrol95 (Euro95), diesel or lpg, as a national daily average per litre in euro with VAT and excise. Premium petrol, E10, E85 and natural gas are not published. Norway: petrol95 (95-octane unleaded) or diesel, as a national monthly average per litre in NOK with taxes. Premium petrol, E10, E85, LPG and CNG are not published. NZ: diesel, or petrol95 (MBIE's Premium Petrol 95R; petrol98 gets the same series). Regular petrol 91 is returned in extra.other_fuels. SG: diesel, petrol95, petrol98 (92-octane petrol is in extra.other_fuels) or lpg (per kg). TH: petrol95 (ULG 95; petrol98 gets the same series), diesel (HSD B7) or lpg (automotive LPG per litre). Gasoline 91 and kerosene are in extra.other_products. TW: diesel (premium diesel), petrol95 (95 unleaded) or petrol98 (98 unleaded), in NT$ per litre with VAT and excise. 92 unleaded and 95E3 gasohol are in the extra fields. US: petrol95 = regular gasoline, petrol98 = premium gasoline, diesel = on-highway diesel (all types). For midgrade gasoline use petrol95 with gasoline_grade=midgrade. Prices are weekly averages in US dollars per gallon, taxes included (US$ per litre is in extra). EIA publishes no E10, E85, LPG or CNG prices. US heating: heating_oil = residential No. 2 heating oil, propane = residential propane, as a national weekly average in US dollars per gallon (per litre in extra). Collected only October to March, so in summer the newest week is from March. For gasoline and diesel use petrol95 or diesel. Uruguay: petrol95 (Super 95) or diesel (gasoil 10-S), as the regulated maximum price per litre in Uruguayan pesos with IVA; premium 97 and gasoil 50-S are in the extra fields. Other fuels are not published.

gasoline_grade.description: US only: the gasoline grade EIA publishes. Overrides the grade implied by fuel (petrol95 = regular, petrol98 = premium); use midgrade here with fuel=petrol95. Not for diesel.

postcode.description: Postcode of the place. AU (Queensland only): 4-digit postcode starting with 4, e.g. '4122'. Most single postcodes have fewer than 5 stations of one fuel; use area 'Brisbane' or 'QLD' then. AU (Western Australia only): 4-digit postcode starting with 6, e.g. '6000'. BR: not used (the survey is published by state and municipality). Ontario: not used. Canada: not used. CO: not used. Costa Rica: not used; one national price is returned and says so. ES: 5-digit postcode, e.g. '28001'. EU Weekly Oil Bulletin countries: not used; the bulletin publishes one national average per country, so the national figure is returned and says so. Finland: not used; Statistics Finland publishes one national average, so the national figure is returned and says so. FR: 5-digit postcode, e.g. '75015'. GB: not used; DESNZ publishes one UK average, so the national figure is returned and says so. HK: not used (territory-wide figure only). Montenegro: not used; one national price is returned and says so. MX: not used. MY: not used (national price only). Netherlands: not used; CBS publishes one national average, so the national figure is returned and says so. Norway: not used; SSB publishes one national average, so the national figure is returned and says so. NZ: not used (national price only). SG: not used (national price only). TH: not used (national price only). TW: not used (island-wide price only). US: not used (EIA publishes no ZIP-code prices). US heating oil and propane: not used (national average only). Uruguay: not used; ANCAP publishes one national price, so the national figure is returned and says so.

service.description: Self-service or attended service, where a country prices them differently. Ontario: not used (the survey does not split self and full service). Canada: self only. Full-service prices stopped in 2013. CO: not used. Costa Rica: not used. EU Weekly Oil Bulletin countries: not used. Finland: not used. GB: not used. HK: not used. IT: self-service (default) or attended service, which costs more. Montenegro: not used. MY: not used. Netherlands: not used. Norway: not used. NZ: not used. TH: not used. TW: not used. US: not used. US heating oil and propane: not used. Uruguay: not used.

tax.description: EU Weekly Oil Bulletin countries only: 'with' (default) = the pump price with all duties and taxes; 'without' = the Commission's price net of duties and taxes (VAT and excise removed), the basis many fuel-surcharge indices use. The answer states which. Other countries refuse it with a 400 (they publish pump prices with taxes only).

town.description: Town name. AU (Queensland only): suburb name, e.g. 'Mount Gravatt'. Small suburbs may have fewer than 5 stations. AU (Western Australia only): suburb name, e.g. 'Rockingham'. Small suburbs may have fewer than 5 stations; use a postcode, 'Perth' or 'WA' then. BR: municipality, e.g. 'São Paulo' or 'Curitiba'; add area when the name exists in several states. Ontario: one of Windsor, London, Peterborough, St. Catharines, Sudbury, Sault Ste. Marie, North Bay, Timmins, Kenora, Parry Sound, Toronto East, Toronto West, or Ontario / Southern Ontario / Northern Ontario for the averages. Ottawa, Thunder Bay and Toronto (city) are answered from Statistics Canada. Canada: one of the 18 cities Statistics Canada tracks (St. John's, Charlottetown and Summerside, Halifax, Saint John, Québec, Montréal, Ottawa-Gatineau, Toronto, Thunder Bay, Winnipeg, Regina, Saskatoon, Edmonton, Calgary, Vancouver, Victoria, Whitehorse, Yellowknife), or 'Canada' for the national average (regular unleaded only). Leave town and area out for the national average. CO: municipality, for example 'Medellin' or 'Cali'. Needs at least 5 reporting stations. Costa Rica: not used (national price only). ES: town name, e.g. 'Valencia'. EU Weekly Oil Bulletin countries: not used (national average only). Finland: not used (national average only). GB: not used (national average only). HK: not used. Prices are for the whole territory; any place is answered with the Hong Kong figure and the answer says so. IT: comune name, e.g. 'Bologna'. Montenegro: not used (national price only). MX: not used for cities; a state name given here works like area. MY: not used. One national price per week; any place is answered with the Malaysia price and the answer says so. Netherlands: not used (national average only). Norway: not used (national average only). NZ: not used. MBIE publishes one national price per week; any place is answered with the New Zealand average and the answer says so. SG: not used. One national price per month; any place is answered with the Singapore average and the answer says so. TH: not used. EPPO publishes one national price per month; any place is answered with the Thailand average and the answer says so. TW: not used. CPC posts one island-wide price; any place is answered with the Taiwan price and the answer says so. US: one of the ten cities EIA publishes (Boston, Chicago, Cleveland, Denver, Houston, Los Angeles, Miami, New York City, San Francisco, Seattle), gasoline only; otherwise the national average is returned and the answer says so. US heating oil and propane: not used (national average only). Uruguay: not used (national maximum price only).

name: pricepaid_fuel_prices_now

outputSchema.description: A price answer: a range or an official statistic with sample size, period, confidence, source and licence.

answer_id.description: Audit trail: a stable id (hash of source id, normalised query, data period and method_version). The same question on the same data gives the same id; keep it with the reasoning that used the figure.

as_of.description: When the answer was produced (ISO 8601); the snapshot date when the official source was down and the answer comes from our copy.

data_age_days.description: Whole days between data_as_of and retrieved_at; null when data_as_of is null.

data_as_of.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the newest data point behind the figure; null when unknown.

evidence.description: Audit trail: what kind of evidence the figure is.

label.description: Short name of the kind of evidence, e.g. 'Recorded sale prices', 'Official published average', 'Official published index', 'Posted shelf or pump price', 'Posted or listed price', 'Contract award value', 'Regulated reimbursement price'.

meaning.description: One sentence on what this kind of evidence does and does not establish.

extra.description: Source-specific details (for example cheapest stations). extra.stale is true when the answer comes from our copy of the source.

method_version.description: Audit trail: version of the way this source turns raw data into an answer (per source, default '1').

notice.description: Information, not a valuation or offer. Also says when the answer is our copy because the official source did not respond.

period.description: The period the records cover (ISO dates), or the date of the snapshot when the answer comes from our copy.

anyOf.description: The price. Null when there is not enough data to publish a figure (fewer than 5 records) or nothing matched.

measure.description: What value is: median for ranges built from records; average or median for official statistics.

typical_high.description: 90th percentile; null for official statistics that give no range.

typical_low.description: 10th percentile; null for official statistics that give no range.

unit.description: What the price is per, e.g. 'per litre', 'per home', 'per kWh'.

value.description: The headline figure. For ranges built from records it equals median.

price_type.description: transaction, posted_pump_price, posted_price, contract_price, reimbursement_price or official_statistic.

query.description: The request as understood, echoed back.

reliability.description: How far to trust the figure as a distribution of real prices. official_with_count = a published official figure with a record count; official_median_no_count = a published average or median with no record count (confidence 'high' there means the publisher is official, not that a count was checked); record_level = 15+ records we hold; thin = 5–14 records; stale = our copy because the official source did not respond; insufficient_data = no figure published.

retrieved_at.description: Audit trail: when ProofPrice produced this answer (ISO 8601). For an answer from our own copy this is now, while as_of is the snapshot date.

sample_size.description: Number of records behind the figure; null when the publisher does not say.

source.description: Where the figure comes from, under which licence, and the attribution line to show.

attribution.description: The attribution line to show with the figure.

url.description: The publisher's page for this data.

statistic.description: Official statistics only: what kind of figure it is and the period the publisher states it for.

status.description: ok = a figure is returned; insufficient_data = fewer than 5 matching records; no_matches = nothing matched.

suggestions.description: Short plain things to try next: widen the period or area, ask for an itemised quote. May be empty.

summary.description: One plain sentence an AI can quote.

title: Live fuel prices at the pump
